LESSON: SIMILARITY AND ENLARGEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: GEOMET RY
Topic 4.3: Similarity and Enlargement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Similarity and Enlargement, part of GEOMET RY in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use enlargeme nt in real life situations? 2. How do we use similarity and enlargeme nt in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Similarity and Enlargement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner develops open mindedness and creativity as they draw similar and

enlarged objects and figures.

● Digital literacy: The learner uses digital devices, software and services to effectively enlarge objects and figures.

Values:
● Responsibility: The learner enriches determination as they collect similar objects and take care of them in the learning

process.

● Social cohesion: The learner enhances co-existence as they work in groups to draw similar objects and figures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Environmental education: The learner appreciates the gift of nature as they collect similar objects from the environment.

Link to other subjects:

Pre-Technical Studies: The learner scale draws similar figures and objects.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Print and Braille Course Book, similar objects of different sizes.
